releaseStatus.note: 2.5.5 is the prepared release candidate; 2.5.4 remains public until signed promotion completes. The candidate adds H.264, H.265, WebM, APNG, GIF, PNG, JPG, and WebP export; full or segmented timelines; live interaction recording; GIF size controls; status-bar progress; bundled verified encoders; and eight media MCP tools for 57 total.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV is a desktop Rive animation viewer and exporter with timeline, still-image, animated-image, live interaction recording, bundled verified encoders, and MCP access.
